```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The budget process has enabled reckless spending by giving procedural cover to Members of Congress.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The budget process defines any earnings the government allows a taxpayer to keep through a deduction, exemption, or credit as equivalent to spending the same amount on some program.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The budget process lumps a broad range of diverse programs under the heading of \"entitlement\".",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The budget process assumes every spending program will be permanent and every tax cut will be temporary.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The budget process refuses to recognize the beneficial budgetary impact of lower tax rates.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The budget process calls a spending increase a cut if it is less than the rate of inflation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republican Members of Congress have repeatedly tried to reform the budget process to make it more transparent and accountable.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republican Members of Congress have voted for a Balanced Budget Amendment to the Constitution.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"33 States have put a Balanced Budget Amendment into their own constitutions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for a Constitutional amendment requiring a super-majority for any tax increase, with exceptions for only war and national emergencies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for imposing a cap limiting spending to the historical average percentage of GDP so that future Congresses cannot balance the budget by raising taxes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
